description: This file defines the abstract class 'Zend_Uri' in the Zend Framework, responsible for representing and handling URI operations such as creation, validation, and string representation. It includes methods for URI scheme management, configuration, and factory-based instantiation of specific URI handlers.

classes.name: Zend_Uri
classes.description: An abstract base class for URI handling in the Zend Framework, providing methods for URI validation, creation, and string representation. Subclasses implement specific URI schemes.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the URI by invoking getUri(), with error handling.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Validates if a given URI string is well-formed by attempting to create a URI object and confirming its validity.

methods.name: factory
methods.description: Creates a specific Zend_Uri subclass instance based on the URI's scheme, handling class loading and validation.

methods.name: getScheme
methods.description: Retrieves the URI's scheme if set, otherwise returns false.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets global configuration options for all URI instances, accepting either an array or Zend_Config object.
